name_zh: 智利·萨尔瓦多·阿连德：社会主义选举与政变自杀新自由主义开端
name_en: Chile Salvador Allende: Socialist Election & Coup Suicide Neoliberal Dawn
description_zh: 萨尔瓦多·阿连德 (1908-1973) 智利总统 (1970-1973)，拉美首位民选社会主义总统，人民团结联盟推行国有化改革，1973年皮诺切特政变空军轰炸总统府，阿连德自杀殉道，新自由主义实验开始。
description_en: Salvador Allende (1908-1973) Chile President (1970-1973), Latin America first democratically elected socialist President, Popular Unity coalition implemented nationalization reforms, 1973 Pinochet coup air force bombed La Moneda, Allende suicide martyrdom, neoliberal experiment began.
reason_zh: 阿连德代表民主道路通向社会主义的拉美尝试与美帝国主义干预的悲剧性终结，展示了民选政府如何在经济战与军事政变双重绞杀下崩溃，其自杀殉道成为拉美左翼永恒精神图腾，政变开启智利新自由主义实验室。
reason_en: Allende represents Latin American democratic road to socialism tragic ending and US imperialist intervention, demonstrating how democratically elected government collapses under economic warfare and military coup dual stranglehold, his suicide martyrdom becoming Latin American left eternal spiritual totem, coup inaugurating Chilean neoliberal laboratory.
steps_zh: 研究阿连德早年医生与社会党参议员生涯
分析1970年人民团结联盟当选与铜矿国有化
探讨美国ITT/中央情报局经济战与卡车司机罢工
评估1973年9月11日政变拉莫内达宫自杀殉道
总结社会主义选举政变自杀新自由主义开端对拉美左翼的永恒创伤与警示
steps_en: Study Allende early doctor and Socialist Senator career
Analyze 1970 Popular Unity election and copper nationalization
Explore US ITT/CIA economic warfare and truckers strike
Evaluate 1973 Sep 11 coup La Moneda bombing suicide martyrdom
Summarize socialist election coup suicide neoliberal dawn eternal trauma and warning for Latin American left
expected_zh: 理解民主社会主义如何在帝国主义干预与国内右翼联盟下崩溃，掌握政变如何为新自由主义实验铺平道路，评估阿连德遗产对智利转型正义与拉美左翼复兴的双重指引。
expected_en: Understand how democratic socialism collapses under imperialist intervention and domestic right-wing alliance, grasp how coup paves way for neoliberal experiment, evaluate Allende legacy dual guidance for Chilean transitional justice and Latin American left revival.
case_zh: 1970 总统；1973 政变自杀；皮诺切特17年；2023年宪法公投。社会主义选举政变自杀新自由范式永存。
case_en: 1970 President; 1973 coup suicide; Pinochet 17 years; 2023 constitutional referendum. Socialist election coup suicide neoliberal paradigm endures.
cross_cultural_impact: Democratic socialism; CIA coup; neoliberalism; suicide martyrdom; constitutional reform
